:::{#def-conditional-surprisal}
#### Conditional surprisal

For $X$ and $Y$ as in @def-joint-surprisal,
the **conditional surprisal** of an [outcome](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-experiment-outcome) $y$ given an outcome $x$
with $\P(X=x) > 0$ and $\P(Y=y \mid X=x) > 0$ is

$$s(y \mid x) \eqdef -\log \P(Y=y \mid X=x).$$

:::
